method: Trailing within-cohort 10-session persistence; all inputs observed no later than completed close T; no forward outcomes used.
warnings: First-reported date alone cannot establish pre-close availability; exclude from time-sensitive historical features.
Do not combine retrospective and canonical cohorts without source-alignment audit.
Persistence is a rolling average of overlapping five-day relative-return indicators.
This is a coverage/feature audit, not an out-of-sample predictive evaluation.
